description:
List the key events (conversions) configured for the GA4 property.

Useful to know which event names count as conversions before building reports or sending events.

propertyId.description: GA4 property ID to query (overrides the default GA_PROPERTY_ID). Accepts "123456789" or "properties/123456789". Use ga_get_account_summaries to discover IDs.

name: ga_list_key_events
